items.title: Athenahealth launches tool to bring patient health records into Anthropic's Claude
items.excerpt: EHR vendor athenahealth is opening patient health records to outside AI assistants, starting with Anthropic's Claude, so patients can ask questions about their own records.

items.title: FDA, CMS scramble to avoid regulatory logjam as more states look to test AI in clinical settings
items.excerpt: Federal officials are moving behind the scenes to head off a conflict between state AI 'sandboxes' that let clinical AI be tested in care and federal device and payment rules.

items.title: 7 Potential Problems with Medicare's AI Prior Authorization Experiment
items.excerpt: An analysis of CMS's WISeR model, which uses AI to flag potentially unnecessary care and speed prior authorization in traditional Medicare, lays out seven risks for patients and providers.

items.title: AI platform maintains success in two pediatric imaging pipelines
items.excerpt: At SIIM-CAIMI 2026, a pediatric hospital reported its in-house AI platform sustained performance in production pipelines for bone-length measurement and fetal MRI.

items.title: RapidAI adds AZmed's x-ray AI to enterprise platform
items.excerpt: RapidAI is integrating AZmed's FDA-cleared x-ray AI applications, including fracture detection, into its enterprise imaging AI platform used by hospitals.

items.title: SIIM-CAIMI: Apollo LLM framework shows promise in patient monitoring
items.excerpt: Faisal Mahmood's team presented updates on Apollo, an LLM framework that summarizes longitudinal patient data for clinical monitoring.

items.title: A clinical multimodal vision language foundation model with fine-grain explainability (EVLF-FM)
items.excerpt: EVLF-FM, a multimodal vision-language foundation model, integrates clinical imaging and text across specialties and gives fine-grained visual explanations for its diagnostic outputs.

items.title: Predicting persistent fever in patients with cancer receiving antibiotics: a machine learning approach
items.excerpt: A machine-learning model predicts which hospitalized cancer patients will stay febrile after starting IV antibiotics, aiming to guide earlier escalation or de-escalation.

items.title: Large language models show product name convergence in drug recommendations
items.excerpt: Across 123 disease-drug pairs and 1,440 sociodemographic profiles, five LLMs repeatedly converged on specific branded products when recommending treatment.

items.title: Wearable devices + AI analysis may predict high blood pressure crisis up to 3 days early
items.excerpt: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 abstract: AI analysis of a cuff BP monitor plus fitness tracker flagged hypertensive crisis risk up to three days ahead; nocturnal patterns and morning surges were top predictors. (Off-list source: AHA primary release, no on-list coverage yet.)

items.title: Non-experts with AI guidance and off-site review perform quality mobile rural heart scans
items.excerpt: AHA 2026 abstract: health workers untrained in ultrasound used real-time AI guidance in a mobile unit to capture quality echocardiograms in rural U.S. communities, reviewed remotely by experts. (Off-list source: AHA primary release.)

items.title: Does ChatGPT Measure Up to Doctors When It Comes to Questions About IVF?
items.excerpt: ASRM 2026: physicians rated ChatGPT's answers on IVF process and risks as clear and generally accurate but less accurate and complete than ASRM patient materials (accuracy 3.98 vs 5.00).

items.title: Governments across Europe and Central Asia unanimously adopt new vision for AI in health care
items.excerpt: The 53 member states of WHO's European Region adopted a regional framework for safe, equitable AI in health systems.

items.title: Partnering with Singapore to bring frontier AI to public health
items.excerpt: Google announced a Singapore health AI research hub and initiatives to support clinicians and public health programs.

items.title: 무릎 심사에 'AI 판독' 활용한 심평원…이의신청까지 확대하나
items.excerpt: 건강보험심사평가원이 무릎관절 진료비 심사에 AI 영상 판독을 도입했지만 '판단 보조 수단'이라며 선을 그었고, AI 판독과 심사자 판단의 일치율·오판독 검증 자료는 아직 없다.

items.title: 일산백병원, AI 기반 중환자 상태 악화 예측 솔루션 도입
items.excerpt: 일산백병원이 EMR의 활력징후·혈액검사 등을 AI로 분석해 상태 악화 위험을 예측하는 에이아이트릭스 'AITRICS-VC'를 도입했다.

items.title: 한미약품, '에피데이' 챗봇에 한국형 LLM 구축
items.excerpt: 한미약품이 퓨리오사AI·엑스페릭스 등과 손잡고 디지털 헬스케어 플랫폼 '에피데이' 환자 챗봇을 자체 한국형 LLM 인프라로 전환한다.

items.title: 의료 AI 정식등재 내년 1분기 윤곽...임시등재 기업들 전환 분수령
items.excerpt: 정부가 AI 의료기술의 건강보험 정식등재 체계 마련에 착수하면서 내년 1분기 윤곽이 나올 전망이고, 임시등재된 의료 AI 기술들의 급여 전환이 분수령을 맞는다.

items.title: 메디인테크, 아주대병원서 국산 AI 로봇내시경 '인티온 에스' 실습 성료
items.excerpt: 의료로봇 스타트업 메디인테크가 아주대병원에서 국산 AI 로봇내시경 '인티온 에스' 임상 실습을 진행했다.

items.title: [미래 헬스케어 트렌드] 숨빗AI 백재민 이사 "AI가 판독문 초안 작성, 전문의는 검토·수정…판독 시간 42% 줄였다"
items.excerpt: 숨빗AI는 AI가 영상 판독문 초안을 쓰고 전문의가 검토·수정하는 방식으로 판독 시간을 42% 줄였다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 용인세브란스병원, 흉부 엑스레이로 심장 기능 저하 예측 AI 개발
items.excerpt: 용인세브란스병원 연구팀이 흉부 X선 영상만으로 좌심실 박출률 저하(심장 기능 저하)를 예측하는 AI 모델을 개발·검증했다.
